segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combo-oily skin report the cream cleanser cleanses without stripping and several say their skin has become less oily over time, though some initially doubted a non-foaming cleanser could suit oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe it as hydrating and non-drying, though one normal-to-dry reviewer felt tight and stripped afterward.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, including some leaning oily, call it their go-to cleanser and report balanced, non-stripped skin.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers (including sensitized by medicated or salicylic-acid cleansers) most consistently report it as gentle, non-irritating and non-drying, with several using it long-term without issue.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 50s and another approaching middle age call it the best cleanser they've used and appreciate that it doesn't foam or strip aging skin.

concerns.aging: One reviewer in her 50s and another near middle age report plump, healthy-looking skin and prefer its gentle, non-foaming action over stripping cleansers typically marketed to youth.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it leaves skin soft, hydrated and not stripped even without added moisturizer; a few dissent, reporting tightness, stripping, or dryness (especially without pairing it with Blume's Whirl product).
concerns.redness: A small number of reviewers note reduced redness and calmer skin, with one specifically linking it to consistent use alongside other Blume products.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers moving away from harsh or foaming cleansers report the product feels calming and non-stripping to a compromised or reactive barrier.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers bought it for daughters or sons dealing with acne and dark spots and report gradual improvement in acne, though dark spot improvement is only hoped for, not confirmed.
concerns.blemishes: Many acne-prone reviewers, teens and adults, report fewer breakouts and calmer skin, often combined with other Blume products (Meltdown, Whirl, Milky Fade); however, a few report no improvement, gritty texture in a later bottle, or increased breakouts.
concerns.oiliness: Several oily-skin reviewers report their skin produces less oil over time and no longer feels the need for stripping foaming cleansers, calling this counterintuitive but effective.

extraits.texte: Having combo skin (more on the oily side) I had always opted for cleansers that stripped away all my natural oils to feel "clean" but little did I know back then that's the worst thing you can do for oily skin. Since I found Blume products, my skin has never looked better. I love how natural the ingredients are and no harsh chemicals are used. My face feels clean and supple, not stripped and dry like most cleansers. It creates a healthy balance and I have WAYYYY less breakouts than before. I used to have uncontrollable cystic acne around my chin that drastically improved after using this brand and now I rarely ever have them. If I do I use the Melt Down and it really helps. Battling oily skin by stripping away the oil is such a no go. I'm so happy I found this product and learned how to actually care for my skin. Please don't ever stop making this!! I'm already torn up that Stargirl is no longer available!

I have oily, sensitive skin and hormonal acne. This face wash doesn't strip the oils from my face, causing oil over production. Combined with melt down, I'm acne free for the first time since puberty. This stuff is life changing!

extraits.titre: Loved the first bottle second bottle was gritty
extraits.texte: I have super sensitive acne prone skin. The first bottle of this was amazing. So hydrating without cause if any breakouts. However, the second bottle I got had a weird gritty texture. Not sure if I will buy it again.

extraits.titre: Can't Decide If I Like It Or Not
extraits.texte: First I'm surprised by all the comments about the scent- it smells lotion-y if that makes sense but I didn't find it overpowering. I have normal to dry skin and for me it leaves my skin feeling kind of tight/stripped. My other cleanser (Glow Recipe Blueberry Bounce) makes my skin feel so soft and hydrated. I did also notice there was still some makeup coming off on my towel after using this, which was disappointing. But I will say that looking at my skin in the mirror after using it, my skin did look very clear and tight and clean and smooth, which I like. So as I said, I'm torn lol.

i rarely write reviews but this legit did nothing for my skin... it doesn't even lather in your hands. you could just not wash your face and get the exact same results. i gave it a solid 2 weeks to work and ended up breaking out more than usual, not like a reaction but i knew it wasn't doing anything. not sure if i got a bad batch or something but it absolutely did not work. wish i could get my money back.
I've been using this for over a year now and I love it! I have dry sensitive skin and it works great!

I've for so many years dealt with acne and have spent thousands of dollars on products that didn't work. My skin is sensitive and Daydreamer Face wash hasn't broke my face out. It cleans and leaves my face bright. I've only been using it for a few days and can see a differene in my pores.
